title: Assert gate: a failed <assert> names its rule and keeps the proofs of the products made before it
proves: a project states business rules as <assert> and Build proves its expectations
a failed <assert> stops a normal run with its message and makes Build reject with assert_failed at the path of the assert
Build keeps the captures of the products that completed before the failed assert and evaluates their expectations
Build lists the expectations it could not evaluate because the run stopped (not_executed)
the failed row (first, middle or last) does not change the diagnostics: the product that holds the assert is never captured in part
Build shows the message only when it is a literal text; a message that can hold an interpolated value is not shown
a condition that raises stays child_execution: it is a broken expression, not a broken rule
